newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Clan rebel leader kidnapped in Somali capital.
newsitem.headline: Clan rebel leader kidnapped in Somali capital.

text.p: A Somali clan rebel leader who heads the Rahanwein Resistance Army (RRA) was kidnapped in northern Mogadishu by five unidentified gunmen, witnesses said on Saturday.
They said Ali Aden Margus was seized from a taxi on Friday night.
The RRA has fought a hit-and-run campaign against forces led by south Mogadishu-based faction leader Hussein Aideed since they seized the major southern town of Baidoa in September 1995.
The kidnappers fired assault rifles and his two bodyguards failed to respond, apparently as they saw they were outgunned. Margus was bundled into a car by the gunmen and driven away, witnesses said.
Relatives said the kidnapping might be linked to demands for compensation for a truckload of food looted by fellow clansmen of Margus. They said no demand for a ransom had been received.
Margus narrowly escaped being kidnapped in northern Mogadishu last week. Somalia has had no central government since the overthrow of late dictator Mohamed Siad Barre in 1991.
